tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and video background. A cool neutral so photos are judged on true colour.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the app-window mockup body, inspector panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Chips, hovered rows, the filmstrip tray, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: The app icon's body colour. Large brand blocks and the icon plate; never a text ground in light theme.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers, 1px.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, EXIF values, captions on ground, surface and surface-raised (5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The RAW badge orange. Primary buttons, the RAW file badge, active-preset state, focus ring in dark. A fill: text on it uses on-amber.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icons on amber fills (9:1).

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber as text or a 1–2px mark (links, active labels, focus ring in light) on ground and surface.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Sunset ramp stop 1: the sun in the icon. Photo-frame art, video transitions. Decorative only.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Sunset ramp stop 2: the near mountain. Decorative fills only, never a state.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Sunset ramp stop 3: the evening sky. Decorative fills only.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Sunset ramp stop 4: the far mountain and the loupe ring. Decorative fills; the cool counterweight to amber.

tokens.name: teal-ink
tokens.usage: Teal as text: preset category labels on ground and surface.

tokens.name: check
tokens.usage: The icon's check badge. Success: copy finished, marked for import. Always paired with a check icon or word. Text on ground and surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete-from-card and failed copy. Always paired with a word. Text on ground and surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind white caption text laid over a photo in the video.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero headline, one per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines on the landing page.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Insert the card. Every RAW opens instantly, no import.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Mark the keepers, copy only those, eject.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Works on macOS 14 Sonoma and later
styles.usage: Fine print under buttons, image captions.

styles.name: exif
styles.usage: EXIF strips, file names, sizes, counts.

styles.name: file-badge
styles.usage: The format badge on a thumbnail.

styles.name: video-caption
styles.usage: Supporting line under a headline, or a lower-third over footage.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gaps inside a control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, thumbnail grid gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between grouped controls.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between feature cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones; video safe margin is 2× this.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, file badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, inspector groups (matches the app's 6pt panels).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App-window mockup, video frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Rating and status pills only.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The macOS app-window mockup in the hero and video. The only shadow in the system.
